concept: Button is a key on the case of an appliance: a capsule of the same matte plastic that drops by its height when pressed and returns on the spring, with only the unit's one primary key dyed orange.

default_to_avoid.pattern: flat pill button with primary, secondary and ghost intent fills (Material contained/outlined/text, shadcn button)
default_to_avoid.why_not: Intent fills spend colour on every button, while P1 allows exactly one orange part per unit and everything else must be plastic.

default_to_avoid.pattern: button that scales down or lifts on hover
default_to_avoid.why_not: A real key neither grows nor rises when a finger approaches it; P6 forbids the hover lift and P3 makes the press a drop in height.

references.source: Braun SK 4 radio-phonograph (Dieter Rams, Hans Gugelot, 1956): rows of plain keys printed beside their function
Braun ET 66 calculator (Dietrich Lubs, 1987): body-coloured keys with one coloured key for the main action
system/refs/ref-01.png: tuner 1 with FM/AM keys and one orange control per unit (estimated from chat)

derivation.form: A text button is a capsule key with corner.round, wide enough for its printed word, at least 44px tall.

derivation.consequence: press drops height to 0 in 60–70ms, return runs on the material's spring
derivation.form: Active state removes elevation.part and moves the key by motion.press-travel in motion.press; release eases back over motion.release.

derivation.consequence: orange appears once per unit, on the primary control's body only
derivation.form: kind primary paints action.accent with an action.accent-rim edge; kind key stays surface.raised plastic with printed ink.

derivation.consequence: no hover lift; hover only darkens a key's ink a step
derivation.form: Hover changes the printed ink one step (or the orange one step on primary) and never translates or scales the key.

derivation.consequence: one grotesk, regular and medium only
derivation.form: The word on the key is type.label in type.weight-medium, sentence case, never bold and never all caps.

options.name: capsule key, word on the key

variants.reason: A keeps the word on the key, so labels of any length stay legible and the hit area grows with them (P3, P5); B is kept for IconButton where no word is needed, and C's squarish keys belong to dense keypads rather than a unit's main action.

root.why: A capsule key of matte plastic, at least 44px tall, sized by the word printed on it.

key.why: A body-coloured key carries printed ink at 4.5:1 or more and spends no accent colour.

primary.why: The unit's one primary key is dyed orange with a darker rim that holds 3:1 against the body.

md.why: The default key is 44px tall, the smallest target every part in dial keeps.

lg.why: A larger 52px key for the main action on a phone sheet held in one hand.

label.why: The printed word uses the label size in medium weight so it reads like printing on a case.

full.why: A full-width key spans the inner width of its unit, aligned to the inset like the display above it.

hover.why: Hover darkens the printed ink one step and never lifts the key, because real keys do not rise.

active.why: Pressing drops the key by its travel and collapses its shadow underneath it, at once.

focus-visible.why: Every part shows the same dark ring with a plastic halo, so focus never depends on the orange.

disabled.why: A disabled key loses its height and fades to half, while its outline stays readable against the body.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduce motion the key changes state at once with no travel and no spring return.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the key keeps a real border so its edge survives without shadows or fills.

transform.why: The key travels down in 65ms and returns on the spring so a press reads as a physical stroke.

box-shadow.why: The cast shadow collapses with the press and grows back with the return, following the single light.

color.why: The ink step on hover fades briefly so the change is a reply, not a flash.

background-color.why: The primary key's orange shifts one step on hover with the same brief fade as the ink.
